text:
Nora K: Quick ask—can we pilot a tiny 'thank-you' station by the elevators next Thursday during peak exit (4:45-5:15)? small sticky notes + pens, leave a quick thanks for a teammate.
Ava (People Ops): Love this. Low lift. How many notes should we prepare?
Nora K: Thinking 100 sticky notes, a handful of pens, and a clear box to collect notes for voluntary routing.
Elliot J: I can handle the print and grab sticky pads from Supplies. Will need 24h notice.
Hana R: I'll volunteer to staff 4:45-5:15 and help route notes to mailroom afterwards.
Ava (People Ops): Cool. I'll approve $40 for supplies and add a small blurb to the weekly roundup to nudge managers.
LogisticsBot: Supplies request logged: ticket 9921. ETA pickup: 24 hours.
Nora K: Simple poster copy: "One quick note. One big thanks." QR optional? maybe not, keep tactile.
Ava (People Ops): Keep it tactile. We'll run it as a micro-experiment and gather feedback. Nora, drop a one-paragraph runbook (setup + where to leave box) and I'll schedule the manager nudge.
Nora K: Runbook posted: 1) pick up supplies at Mailroom, 2) set table by elevators 4:30, 3) staff 4:45-5:15, 4) drop collected notes to Mailroom at 5:30.
Ava (People Ops): Great. Thanks team! :sparkles: We'll reconvene here after the event with a short survey.
